name: IPLStatusRule
title: IPL status rule
description: The rule that set an IPL entry's status.

concept.definition: The report states an absence, and no earlier report stated the finding present.
The report states an absence after an earlier presence.
The report states an absence after the entry has resolved.
The radiologist reported the finding new.
The radiologist stated the finding chronic, remote, or healed at its first observation or when present after an absence.
The radiologist reported the finding for the first time, with no comparison wording and no stated age that predates the examination.
The radiologist reported the finding present after an absence, including a recurrence after resolution, with no comparison wording and no stated age that predates the examination.
The radiologist wrote no comparison wording, and a stated attribute contradicts its last stated value.
The radiologist wrote no comparison wording, and no stated attribute contradicts its last stated value.
The entry holds only absences, and a radiologist reported a finding of its type present within its site after the last absence, so that finding's entry carries the status.
